Represents the configuration settings for a messaging queue, including its name, connection details, subscription name, and various operational parameters.

Remarks

This class is typically used to bind configuration sections from appsettings or other configuration sources for messaging queue consumers or producers.

Connectivity is declared either with ConnectionString (shared access key) or with FullyQualifiedNamespace (Entra ID credential). When both are present the connection string wins.

Properties

AutoCompleteMessages

Gets or sets a value indicating whether messages should be automatically completed after processing. Default is false.

public bool AutoCompleteMessages { get; set; }

bool

ConnectionString

Gets or sets the connection string used to connect to the messaging service. Leave empty to authenticate with an Entra ID credential against FullyQualifiedNamespace.

public string? ConnectionString { get; set; }

Property Value

FullyQualifiedNamespace

Gets or sets the fully qualified namespace of the messaging service (for example contoso.servicebus.windows.net), used when authenticating with an Entra ID credential instead of a connection string.

public string? FullyQualifiedNamespace { get; set; }

Property Value

string

ManagedIdentityClientId

Gets or sets the client ID of the user-assigned managed identity to authenticate with when FullyQualifiedNamespace is used and no explicit credential is supplied. Leave empty to use the identity named by the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable, then the system-assigned identity or the ambient developer credential.

public string? ManagedIdentityClientId { get; set; }

Property Value

string
